map.name: Direct Fire
map.author: Vechs
map.conversion: Original map upgraded by vanilla server; distinct from the earlier Java 1.21 conversion package.

timing.includes: Reasoning, script editing, observation hookup changes, gameplay and recovery.

outcome.reason: Evaluation ended after repeated recovery cycles; world preserved for subsequent work.

shaft.note: Partially sealed working shaft, not a completed safe return route.

persistentProgress.verification: Read from saved world NBT after normal shutdown.

statistics.note: Low-level bridge requests are not model calls or successful task counts.

limitations: Initial player-written SDK harness omitted the default observer/inbox. Hookup and cursor handling were repaired during the run.
Later user and supervisor feedback was supplied; this is not an independent blinded model benchmark.
Native coding agent with a local relay; not the full Pi/container/budget gateway deployment.
An emitted event or fresh snapshot alone does not establish that the model consumed it at that moment.

findings.observation: Crafting coincided with repeated terminated disconnects and navigation goal resets.
findings.verification: Separate deterministic native-inventory plus HTTP reproduction showed two 46-slot updates overfilled the queue for an actively reading client. Candidate coalesces synchronous slot notifications.

findings.observation: Falling during dig/edge-positioning lost the initial equipment.
findings.verification: Separate representative terrain plus physics reproduction identified entering horizontal placement before landing. Original per-tick path was not recorded; this is not a complete live replay.

findings.observation: Immediately after closing a transfer window the SDK could briefly retain old carried inventory.
findings.verification: Native inventory versus delayed SSE/HTTP comparison reproduced a missing completion barrier.

findings.observation: Five logs produced twenty planks, then an erroneous additional recipe iteration failed.
findings.verification: Bridge used one number as both result-item quantity and recipe-iteration count.

findings.observation: A bat about 1.1 blocks away was omitted by risk-ranked summary; raw entity query exposed it during placement troubleshooting.
findings.verification: Targeted geometry query is additional evidence, not proof of server rejection cause.

findings.observation: Partial route construction persisted, but exposed pauses, incomplete enclosure, resource recovery and target selection repeatedly lost time and equipment.
